subject: Re: Request: price parity / commit options vs OpenAI & Anthropic
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrise.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Chen <mchen@skyrise.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Price parity ask + commit options vs OpenAI / Anthropic

Hi Vivek,

Following up from our demo last week — procurement pulled together the usage data and we need to validate whether Redwood can match or beat the competitive per-token pricing our finance team is seeing from OpenAI and Anthropic for both chat (gpt-style) and embeddings. High level: 800M tokens/month today (mix: ~75% chat, 25% embeddings), expected growth to ~2B over 12 months if unit economics are favorable.

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood provide a per-token parity proposal vs the published Anthropic/OCI discounts for chat and embeddings?
- What committed tiers would you require for the parity pricing? (monthly vs annual)
- Any added SLAs / credits you can include for Hosted API customers at that commit level?
- Sample redlines on billing terms (invoices/PO timing / net-45) — procurement will need this.

We want to avoid re-architecting to your Dedicated offering immediately; hosted API economics need to look comparable. Marcus (cc) is on procurement — looping him in for the billing questions.

Thanks — Sam

--
Sam Patel
Head of ML Platform, Skyrise AI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrise.ai>
Cc: Marcus Chen <mchen@skyrise.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price parity ask + commit options vs OpenAI / Anthropic

Sam — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear usage profile. Attached is a first-pass price sheet (skyrise_price_sheet_v1.xlsx) and a simple commit matrix that maps monthly/annual tiers to per-token rates for both chat and embeddings. High level summary in-line: 

- Parity target: we can match your guidance for chat at the ~0.36/1k prompt+0.12/1k completion equivalent range if you commit to a 12-month annualized spend with a 20% up-front minimum (effectively a 3-month prepay).
- Embeddings: because of lower compute per-embed and cache savings, we can offer a steeper discount at larger commits (2B+ tokens/mo -> ~35% off list).
- Alternative monthly commit (no prepay) requires a higher effective rate (~15% higher than annual).

Two commercial notes:
1) Hosted API parity is conditioned on your token mix profile; if chat % increases beyond 80% we may need to revisit the rate due to completion tail costs.
2) We include a baseline SLA (99.9%) for annual committed accounts at the 1B+ tier; SLA credits are described on page 2 of the attached SOW draft.

Next steps: Ben will follow up with a simplified quote that maps to your usage buckets and call out the legal/billing language we can accept for net-45 and PO flow. If that looks good we can produce a DocuSign-ready quote and an MSA redline.

Would love to schedule a short call (30m) today or tomorrow to walk the numbers — is 11am PT doable?

Best,
Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrise.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Chen <mchen@skyrise.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price parity ask + commit options vs OpenAI / Anthropic

Sam — quick follow-up with some assumptions I used in the attached commit_matrix.csv. A few clarifications that materially change per-token math: 
- Definition of a token (your ingestion/normalization): do you include user metadata tokens in accounting? We usually bill on model tokens only but can map to effective application tokens.
- Completion length: your average completion is ~220 tokens — we modeled at 200 for safety.
- Burst tolerance: do you need burst headroom above committed baseline? We can structure a buffer window (pay-as-you-go above commit) at a slightly reduced premium.

If you can confirm those three, I'll push a cleaned quote showing per-token blended rates for your current 800M profile and the 2B projected profile. 

Quick ask: can procurement accept a 60-day review window for the price parity clause? That protects both parties if market rates shift.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Commercial
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrise.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Chen <mchen@skyrise.ai>, Procurement <procurement@skyrise.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price parity ask + commit options vs OpenAI / Anthropic

Ben — answering inline: 
- Token definition: yes, we want model tokens only. App-level metadata is tracked separately.
- Avg completion: correct, roughly 220; you can use 220 for the blended example.
- Burst: we'll likely need up to 1.5x baseline for unpredictable spikes during feature launches. Buffer window sounds reasonable — please show costs.

Procurement note (Marcus): net-45 is preferred; Skyrise legal will need to review parity clause language and the 60-day market review window — please include sample clause.

We'll do 11am PT today for the walk-through. I'll distribute calendar invite.

Sam
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrise.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Chen <mchen@skyrise.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price parity ask + commit options vs OpenAI / Anthropic

Thanks for the call earlier — notes and a cleaner commercial option attached. Key changes from the v1 sheet: 
- Offer A (12mo annualized): 1.2B token commit monthly avg (annualized) -> chat $0.00033 per token (prompt+comp blended), embeddings $0.000022 per token. Includes 1% monthly cost credit for first 3 months if usage dips below commit.
- Offer B (monthly commit): 900M commit -> chat $0.00042, embeddings $0.00003; 30-day cancel with 60-day notice on price reviews.
- Burst: extra capacity billed at a 10% premium above the committed per-token rate for the first 50% above commit, then pay-as-you-go thereafter.
- Legal: included a 60-day market parity review clause draft and sample SLA credit calculation.

I've attached SOW_skyrise_draft.pdf that includes SLAs and a DocuSign quote link placeholder. If procurement can accept net-45 and the 3-month prepay for Offer A we can lock in the parity numbers.

Next step: I can generate a DocuSign-ready quote (Offer A) and share a HubSpot opp link for signatures, or we can iterate if procurement wants different billing cadence.

— Lauren
Principal, Strategic Accounts
From: Procurement <procurement@skyrise.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrise.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price parity ask + commit options vs OpenAI / Anthropic

Lauren / Ben — procurement reviewed Offer A. Two procurement asks before we move to signature: 
1) Can you make the 3-month prepay optional and instead require a smaller initial deposit (10%) with remaining invoiced monthly?
2) We need a firm escalation path and a single point of contact for incidents tied to the SLA (preferably an on-call engineer).

Also please confirm whether the parity pricing will be guaranteed for the 12-month term subject to the 60-day review (i.e., changes only if both parties agree after review). If you can update the DocuSign package with these changes we can aim to return a signed copy within 7 business days.

Regards,
Marcus Chen
Procurement Lead, Skyrise AI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@skyrise.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrise.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price parity ask + commit options vs OpenAI / Anthropic

Marcus — appreciate the clear asks. Agreed path forward: 
- We'll rework Offer A: make the 3-month prepay optional. New options will be 10% deposit + monthly invoicing (net-45) — see updated pricing row in the attached skyrise_price_sheet_v1.xlsx.
- We'll name an on-call incident contact (Level 2 eng): Rahul Singh (redwood_oncall@redwood.com) and include the escalation matrix in the SOW.
- Parity pricing: we'll commit to the parity rates for the 12-month term; the 60-day market review is a bilateral mechanism — pricing changes require mutual written agreement.

I'll ask Lauren to generate a DocuSign quote with these edits (Offer A, 10% deposit option). Once we have the DocuSign link I'll share it to the HubSpot opp (opp-SKY-2027-042) and target signature within 7 business days.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this.

Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
